title: Announce session metadata changed by observation-retention during a narrow commit
outcome: A hidden session retained for an unresolved source-observation duty has any newly visible session metadata announced coherently when a test-run observation uses the narrow persistence commit, without restoring routine full-state broadcasts.
acceptance: A deterministic control drives a hidden duty-bearing session through the actual narrow observation commit and observes whether visibility, preview and dispatch blocking changed.
A documented and reviewed publication policy makes retention-induced session metadata visible to existing clients while ordinary observation commits still emit zero full-state events.
The retention control and existing observation publication/persistence controls pass on the exact changed input.
